use_case: AI-assisted emergency call triage: live transcription of calls with a suggested call type, response priority, and critical-keyword alerts inside the CAD
business_owner: Ambulance Services chief medical officer (clinical); BDS vice president of communications operations (operational)
vendor_or_model: CAD vendor AI module (speech-to-text plus a language model classifier), cloud service
data_categories: Live call audio; transcripts; caller-reported symptoms and location; suggested call type and priority (ePHI of Ambulance Services and, until 2026-10-07, of client agencies)
human_in_the_loop: Telecommunicator runs the emergency medical dispatch protocol and sets every priority; the AI may only prompt an upgrade, never a downgrade; no automatic dispatch
applicable_laws: HIPAA (CAD vendor BAA amended 2026-04-30 for internal divisions only; client callers excluded since 2026-10-07); 45 CFR 92.210 (treated as a patient care decision support tool); state recording laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(g) worked example; counsel to confirm coverage of BDS centers); Fla. Stat. 501.171; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production with conditions: advisory mode for internal English-language calls at the Florida center; shadow mode elsewhere; no expansion until conditions are met
division: Billing and Dispatch Services (serving Ambulance Services)

use_case: ePCR narrative drafting: vendor feature that drafts the patient care narrative from structured fields entered by the crew
data_categories: Structured patient care fields; draft narrative (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if it suggests treatments
human_in_the_loop: Crew must review, edit, and sign every narrative
applicable_laws: HIPAA (ePCR BAA confirmed to cover the feature with no training on group data); state EMS records accuracy (Fla. Stat. 401.30(1) worked example)
status: Pilot on 300 tablets; expansion paused until accuracy targets are met

use_case: System status management model recommending where to post available ambulances each hour
vendor_or_model: In-house demand forecasting and optimization model
data_categories: CAD incident history (locations, times, call types); unit status
human_in_the_loop: Deployment analysts and shift supervisors approve each posting plan; supervisors can override at any time
applicable_laws: County ambulance agreements (response standards); HIPAA (CAD history); 45 CFR 92.210 not applicable (does not support a decision about an individual patient)
status: In production since 2024; first council assessment; continue with equity monitoring

use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe) drafting urgent care visit notes from recorded conversations
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (speech-to-text and language model)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if suggestion features are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Provider reviews, edits, signs, and attests every note
applicable_laws: HIPAA (vendor BAA with no-training terms); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example); 45 CFR 92.210 if suggestion features are enabled
status: In production (140 providers in 2 states); expansion paused until the consent field is mandatory

use_case: Online symptom checker chatbot that suggests urgent care, emergency department, or calling 911
vendor_or_model: Symptom checker vendor (rules plus a language model)
human_in_the_loop: None designed yet; the tool would talk to patients directly
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210; HIPAA (BAA required); FTC Act Section 5 (claims); FDA device status is the vendor's question

use_case: Ambulance claim coding assistant that suggests level of service and medical necessity codes from the ePCR
vendor_or_model: Revenue cycle platform vendor feature (language model)
data_categories: ePCR narratives and fields (PHI of internal and client patients)
human_in_the_loop: Certified coders accept or change every suggestion before a claim is released
applicable_laws: Medicare ambulance rules (42 CFR 410.40); client BAAs (the feature must be permitted for each client); SOC 2 commitments (Processing Integrity)

use_case: Claim denial prediction model that ranks denied claims for appeal work
human_in_the_loop: Analysts decide which claims to appeal

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant under a BAA with no-training terms
data_categories: Internal documents; PHI only in the enterprise tenant for approved roles
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for dispatch, clinical, or coding decisions
